resale_co.name: Certificate of Occupancy (CO) Resale / Exterior Resale Certification (Exterior Housing Code Inspection, Borough Code Section 227-3)
resale_co.issued_by: Collingswood Fire Department, Office of Fire Prevention & Inspection Bureau
resale_co.valid_for: 6 months from the date of inspection, or one change of ownership, whichever comes first
requirements: Exterior only: sidewalks, walkways, curbing, driveways and aprons, exterior stairs and handrails, house numbers
Sidewalks and walkways free of trip hazards (1/2 inch or more height difference between blocks, or cracks 1/4 inch or wider); bad blocks replaced, not patched; Public Works permit needed
Curbs free of disintegration and cracks over 1/2 inch
Driveways in good condition, at least 9 by 18 feet; dirt, grass, gravel, stone or shell surfaces not allowed
Exterior stairs with more than 4 risers or over 30 inches high need handrails and guards
House numbers at least 3 1/2 inches high, readable from the street
Repairs must be finished within 30 days of notice; a shade tree permit is needed if trees are in the curb strip
No open construction permits and no outstanding zoning violations (signed affidavits from the Construction Office and Zoning Office)

fees.label: Returned check processing fee
fees.quote: All returned checks require a $20.00 processing fee in addition to any bank fees.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Use the combined 'Residential Inspection for Sale of Property Application' (covers both the exterior resale certificate and the fire smoke/CO certificate). Print, complete and deliver it with a check or money order payable to 'Borough of Collingswood' to the Fire Prevention & Inspection Bureau, 434 Haddon Avenue, Collingswood NJ 08108. One check may cover both inspections. Call 856-854-7447 to schedule (inspections Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday, AM or PM). Get the Construction Permit Affidavit and Zoning Official Affidavit in the packet signed.

evidence.quote: There are several types of Certificates of Occupancy (COs). This type is required at the time of resale of any property in the Borough of Collingswood.
Deputy Chief/Fire Official Geoffrey T. Joyce x105 gjoyce@collingswood.com
Borough Ordinance 227-3 requires an Exterior Housing Code Inspection for the sale and/or re-sale of residential and commercial properties with the boundaries of the Borough of Collingswood.
A property shall not be issued an exterior inspection certificate without proof that all Construction Permits or any Zoning concerns have been satisfied
Before any residential or commercial property is sold in the Borough of Collingswood, the current property owner shall obtain a resale certification from the Borough's designated representative.

resale_co.notes: A temporary certificate (up to 6 months) may be issued if weather or other circumstances prevent repairs before settlement; it needs a written, notarized application signed by buyer and seller, a repair estimate, and an escrow at settlement of twice the estimated repair cost. Borough code Section 227-3 (read on ecode360) repeats the $50 fee but says no fee is charged for the first reinspection of completed repairs and $50 for each reinspection after that, while the 2025 application says all re-inspections are $50.00; ask which applies. Rental COs are a separate program (all commercial units and units in triplexes and larger between tenants).

requirements: Working 10-year sealed battery smoke alarm in every bedroom and on every level (hardwired 110V alarms are exempt from the 10-year battery rule but must be tested to NFPA 72 with a test report at inspection)
Smoke alarms on the ceiling at least 4 inches from the wall, or on the wall 4 to 12 inches below the ceiling
CO alarm within 10 feet of each sleeping area

Homes with a secondary power source (generator, solar, battery storage) need a non-handwritten label within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and electric meter, such as 'CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER'
Fire extinguisher no longer required (removed February 2025 under P.L.2025, c.19)
A representative must be present to let the inspector in

authorities.name: Collingswood Fire Department, Office of Fire Prevention & Inspection Bureau
authorities.lead_time: Apply more than 10 days before the inspection appointment for the lower fee. Certificates are valid for one change of ownership or 6 months, whichever comes first.

fees.label: Interior smoke/CO certificate, application more than 10 days before the inspection appointment
Interior smoke/CO certificate, application less than 10 days before the inspection appointment

authorities.how_to_apply: Same combined application as the exterior resale certificate. Submit with a check or money order payable to 'Borough of Collingswood' to 434 Haddon Avenue; fees are due at application. Call 856-854-7447 to schedule.

fire_cert.notes: The 2025 packet says the fire extinguisher section is 'no longer required after Governor Murphy signed P.L.2025, c.19 in to law on February 3, 2025'. Borough code Chapter 163 (read on ecode360) has the same $75 and $150 tiers and $50 reinspection, still under the older CSACMAPFEC (extinguisher) name; its wording describes both tiers as 'within 10 calendar days of the settlement date', while the form ties the cutoff to 10 days before the inspection appointment. The form's wording is used here. Fire Official: Deputy Chief Geoffrey T. Joyce (gjoyce@collingswood.com, ext. 105).

other_items.label: Construction Permit Affidavit
other_items.detail: Construction Office must certify there are no open permits.

other_items.label: Zoning Official Affidavit
other_items.detail: Zoning Office must certify there are no outstanding zoning violations.

other_items.label: Sidewalk/curb repair permit
other_items.detail: Owner must get a Public Works permit before sidewalk or curb repairs; Shade Tree Commission permit if trees are in the curb strip. Public Works: 856-854-0533.

open_questions: No minimum lead time for scheduling is published beyond the 10-day fee cutoff.
Is the first re-inspection of the exterior resale certificate free (Borough code Section 227-3) or $50.00 (2025 application)?
